Tess (CS): drafting a 1-page customer-facing runbook for warmup/prefill + simple rep script. goal: reduce churn risk by smoothing first-24h UX.
Diego (CS Ops): please add quick consent capture (ticket field) and a tiny decision tree for sales. they want yes/no checks only.
Rina (Eng): runtime-safe defaults below (copy/paste):
Rina (Eng): ```yaml
warmup: { enabled: true, minutes: 20, target_concurrency: 2 }
cache: { edge_ttl_seconds: 45, kv_ttl_minutes: 15 }
batching: { max_tokens: 1024, hold_ms: 25 }
streaming: { prefer: true, fallback: non-streaming, partial_timeout_ms: 1200 }
```
Sam (SRE): monitoring checklist: synthetic prefill probe every 3m; page if p95 > 400ms for 10m or error_rate > 2%. add token-usage logging for warmups.
Tess (CS): rep-facing two-line blurb for kickoff emails: "Hi <Name>, we run a short warmup to improve initial latency and UX. No action needed; reply if you want to opt out."
Diego (CS Ops): ticket fields: `prefill_consent: yes/no`, `prefill_notes`. capture objections (cost/privacy) and rep next steps.
Tess (CS): renewal-risk quick rule: < 4 meaningful sessions in 24h AND p95 latency > 250ms for 12h -> auto-flag; if flagged twice in 7 days, schedule health call.
Rina (Eng): ops curl to trigger prefill (ops only):
Rina (Eng): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/prefill \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"T-42","steps":8,"mode":"staggered"}'
```
